name: AI Avatar Portrait
summary: A set of 20 stylised portraits of one face in many looks: fantasy, anime, space and painting. Phone apps made the form common at the end of 2022.

philosophy.core_thesis: One face, many costumes: the pack turns a selfie into a character sheet, and the glow is the reward.
design_principles: Show a pack as a 4x5 grid of 20 square tiles, each 160px with a 6px gap.
Keep the same face in every tile and change the world around it: costume, ground and colour grade.
Set the eyes 10% to 15% larger than natural and smooth the skin to a airbrushed finish.
Put a glow ground behind the head: a radial gradient from #FFC857 to #2B1E5A.
Name each style under the tile in 12px sans, for example Fantasy, Anime, Cosmic.
Add a rounded Save pack button of 48px height in pink (#FF5FA2) below the grid.
Show a before and after pair: the plain selfie at 30% width beside the best result at 70%.
anti_patterns: One uniform look across the pack

layout.grid_mechanics: A 4-column, 5-row tile grid with 6px gaps and a sticky action bar; a hero pair above the grid.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 25% of the screen stays empty; the spacing scale is 6, 12, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero pair and flush-left style names under each tile.
layout.container_geometry: Tiles with a 16px radius; the action button has a full radius; chips have a 12px radius.

font_pairings.note: A round, friendly display face with a soft text face.
A bubbly display face for app-store style captions.

hierarchy_rules: Use 3 weights: regular (400), semibold (600) and bold (700).
Set style names in title case at 12px.
Keep one headline of 4 words at most.

color.palette_structure: A violet night ground with pink, gold and cyan glows, and a pale mist for text.
color.contrast_rules: Mist text on violet holds at least 11:1; pink and gold carry buttons and glows, with dark text on them at 5:1 or more.
color.surface_treatment: Radial glow grounds, soft gradients on tiles and a light sparkle layer at 10% opacity.
color.light_and_shadow: A glow from behind the head, a soft key from the front and a coloured rim in pink or cyan.

materiality.surface_simulation: An airbrushed digital illustration: smooth skin, large eyes and glowing air.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px border in white at 20% on tiles; the selected tile takes a 3px pink border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Glow blur of 16px to 32px behind the head; tiles have a soft shadow of 0 6px 16px at 35% black.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Filled icons at 24px with round terminals inside circles for share and save.
ornamentation_details.illustration: The same face as an elf, a space pilot, an anime lead, an oil painting or a pop star poster.

motion.transition_physics: Tiles pop in one by one at 80ms steps with a 1.08x overshoot; sparkles drift up for 3 seconds.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts the tile 4px and brightens the glow; active scales it to 0.96x.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels playful pride: it is me, in twenty better worlds.

use_cases: photo app marketing and store pages
social posts that show a pack
avoid_when: The content needs honest, unretouched portraits.
The page serves a serious or clinical audience.
Consent for the face images is not clear.

modifiers.how: Use one render with natural skin detail and a rim light; drop the grid.
Use one plain generated headshot with the eye line at 40% and no costume.
Mix random subjects in the grid and add engagement captions.

pack.why: Filled icons in circles match the round, friendly app look of an avatar pack.

ground.why: Soft glow orbs echo the radial light that sits behind each head in an avatar tile.
